beta.changelog: * Noxpress Core 1.2.8: a use-at-your-own-risk notice on the Noxpress hub page, and a Disclaimer section in this readme.

* Newsletter: the form in a popup too (off by default). Opens after 20 seconds or half the page, at most once every 30 days per browser and never after a sign-up; not on the cart, the checkout, the account pages or a page that has the form. localStorage only, no cookie; the same HTML for every visitor. Its own title, text and close label in Greek and English; filter `orc_popup_show`; `?orc_popup=1` to test.
* Newsletter: the shop key is now checked by orOS (Subscribe link → Shop key), so signed checkout sign-ups join without a confirmation email; texts updated.
* Privacy policy text mentions the popup's localStorage entry.
* Noxpress Core 1.2.8: a use-at-your-own-risk notice on the Noxpress hub page, and a Disclaimer section in this readme.
* Noxpress Core 1.2.8: a use-at-your-own-risk notice on the Noxpress hub page, and a Disclaimer section in this readme.
* Noxpress Core 1.2.8: a use-at-your-own-risk notice on the Noxpress hub page, and a Disclaimer section in this readme.

* orOS: the report per product is also readable at wc/v3/pl/report (read only, amounts in cents), so orOS Publishing shows each title's cost and result with the same figures as the report screen: direct costs, its shares of shipping, consumables and payment fees, shipping charged, creator payouts, VAT and break-even.
* Noxpress Core 1.2.8: a use-at-your-own-risk notice on the Noxpress hub page, and a Disclaimer section in this readme.
* Noxpress Core 1.2.8: a use-at-your-own-risk notice on the Noxpress hub page, and a Disclaimer section in this readme.

* New: monthly creator statements (Noxpress → RS Statements). For every beneficiary with a balance or any movement in the month: the opening balance, the share per title (copies, %, amount), the Ledger's other income and payments, and the closing balance. It goes out as a short email with the statement as a PDF attached. No opt-in is needed; beneficiaries can be left out in the settings.
* New: two sending modes. «Review» (default): every statement waits until you press Send (one by one, or the selected ones). «Automatic»: the daily check makes and sends the previous month's statements on the 1st, except statements with a warning, beneficiaries without an email and December statements, which always wait. A statement made by hand is never sent by itself, and turning the feature on never sends an older month.
* New: checks that hold a statement: the VAT RS removes does not fit the product (no tax in WooCommerce, ISBN → 6%, other GTIN → 24%), more copies of one title in a month than a set limit (default 50), a negative balance, no email.
* New: yearly settlement. December's statement is «Year-end settlement» and can be marked «Paid», which adds a Ledger payment of its closing balance (same checks as the Ledger form).
* New: a small built-in PDF writer (no external service or library) with DejaVu Sans (Latin and Greek; licence in assets/fonts). Each PDF embeds only the glyphs it uses.
* New: abilities revenue-splitter/statements-list and revenue-splitter/statement-preview (read-only).
* Fix: the monthly report's «Balance payable» (and the monthly-preview ability's remaining) is now the balance at the end of the month, not on the day the report is sent.

* Initial release.
* Title and description templates with per-object overrides, robots through wp_robots, canonical and pagination.
* One JSON-LD graph (Organization, WebSite with product SearchAction, WebPage, BreadcrumbList, Article, Product from WooCommerce) with the noxpress_seo_graph filter; Open Graph and Twitter cards.
* Sitemaps at Rank Math's addresses (/sitemap_index.xml, /{type}-sitemap{N}.xml) with images and the robots.txt line; /llms.txt without personal data, /llms-full.txt 410; static llms files moved to a backup on a click, with restore.
* Import from Rank Math with dry run and undo; Compare with the live page and the sitemaps; Switch over and Switch back in one click.
* Test mode, passive while another SEO plugin is active, SSG_DISABLE; no external calls and no cookies.
* Abilities search-signals/status, get-meta, set-meta, json-ld, sitemap-status and compare; Greek and English admin.
* Noxpress hub and updates from noxpress.tech (Noxpress Core 1.2.9).

* New: product suggestions under the free-shipping bar while an amount is left. Up to 6 products from a list you choose; the ones that cover the amount left come first, cheapest first; products already in the cart or out of stock are skipped. Simple products add to the cart in place, variable ones open their page. Shown in the cart, hidden in the mini-cart and checkout. Off by default, with editable title and button texts.
* New: the threshold is also read from a carrier method that turns free over an amount of its own: BOX NOW Delivery's "free delivery threshold", when the zone has no Free shipping method with an amount. Filter `shn_carrier_threshold` for other carriers.
* Search Signals: filtered listing pages get noindex, follow through its robots, and the plugin's own canonical tag is left out while Search Signals prints the SEO tags, so a page never has two.

* New: automatic schedule of the write window, per site (Access → Window schedule, off by default). Up to 3 ranges a day in the site's time zone, a range may run past midnight, up to 30 closed dates. Ranges that touch count as one stretch, and no stretch may be longer than 12 hours (the longest manual window); a DST night is cut at 12 hours too. Worked out on every check, so it is right without cron; one WP-Cron event at the next change only writes the log and sends the e-mail.
* New: "Close now" inside a scheduled stretch (WP admin, Hub, app or Claude's write_window_close) pauses the schedule until that stretch ends; the next one opens as planned. Opening by hand inside a stretch keeps the later end.
* New: an e-mail to the admin address for every change of the write window: opened or closed by hand (and by whom: WP admin, Hub, app or Claude), opened or closed by the schedule, paused, and every schedule edit (before and after). Setting in Access, on by default.
* The site's status gives the Hub and the app what keeps the window open (manual / schedule), the next scheduled opening and the end of a pause; the Hub's Sites tab and list_sites show them. The Site Bridge app 1.8.0 notifies about every change.
* The schedule lives in option sbr_schedule, which no Site Bridge tool can write. Uninstall removes it and its cron event.

* Noxpress Core 1.2.8: a use-at-your-own-risk notice on the Noxpress hub page, and a Disclaimer section in this readme.

* New: two more periods, «This month» (from the 1st) and «This year» (from 1 January), for every period setting. «This year» matches the Revenue Splitter widget.
* Changed: «Last month» is now called «Last 30 days», which is what it always counted.
* Changed: the Quick View widget shows the period next to «Publisher profit» and «Owed to others», and a note that the amounts are without VAT, after ledger entries and without shipping.
* Changed: «Owed to others» now counts like the publisher's profit: share plus ledger income minus payments in the period (it was the share only). The per-beneficiary table on the dashboard shows that total under «Net (after deductions)».
* The abilities' period input accepts this_month and year.
* Noxpress Core 1.2.8: a use-at-your-own-risk notice on the Noxpress hub page, and a Disclaimer section in this readme.
